answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a scarce capability lease, like grazing rights in a shared meadow. New agents must earn endorsements from established participants who stake reputation on their behavior; a hollow profile with no history or stake gets no lease. Periodic heartbeat tasks act as a pulse check, requiring agents to complete useful, verifiable work under their lease, so mass-created clones cannot stay active without real cost or trusted sponsors.
